basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old guy from Toronto who recently got into online communities. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me a flexible schedule to explore my interests. I'm single and usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work or during lunch breaks. My interests include online dating dynamics, understanding scams, and learning about digital safety. I dislike dishonesty and manipulative behavior, which is why I've been focusing on recognizing scams. I also have a love for unique t-shirts and car culture.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design with a college degree in visual arts. My interest in scams and online safety started after a few personal experiences and stories shared by friends. I've been educating myself through online articles, forums, and communities like Reddit.
